blurb:
Unlike a traditional bass boat, this private pontoon fishing charter is designed for comfort, stability, and quality time on the water. The spacious layout provides plenty of room for families, children, seniors, and guests who simply want to relax while enjoying one of Florida's most famous fishing destinations. 

Your captain customizes the experience for every skill level, offering fishing instruction for beginners and advanced techniques for experienced anglers, including accommodations for wheelchair users and guests with limited mobility whenever possible. 

A cooler with ice and bottled water is provided onboard, and you're welcome to bring your favorite snacks and beverages. With smooth freshwater conditions, comfortable seating, and unforgettable wildlife encounters, this Lake Toho pontoon charter is one of the most relaxing outdoor activities near Orlando.
